settings.name: USE_UI_SSO
settings.description: Enable or disable UI Single Sign-On authentication for the web interface

settings.name: UI_SSO_PROVIDER
settings.description: Select your SSO provider to auto-configure headers and group parsing. Use 'Custom' for manual header configuration.

settings.name: UI_SSO_HEADER_USERNAME
settings.description: HTTP header containing the authenticated username

settings.name: UI_SSO_HEADER_EMAIL
settings.description: HTTP header containing the user's email address

settings.name: UI_SSO_HEADER_GROUPS
settings.description: HTTP header containing the user's groups (comma or space separated)

settings.name: UI_SSO_HEADER_NAME
settings.description: HTTP header containing the user's display name

settings.name: UI_SSO_TRUSTED_IPS
settings.description: Comma-separated list of trusted IP addresses or CIDR ranges that are allowed to send SSO headers

settings.name: UI_SSO_AUTO_CREATE_USERS
settings.description: Automatically create new users when they authenticate via SSO for the first time

settings.name: UI_SSO_DEFAULT_ROLE
settings.description: Default role assigned to new SSO users when no group mapping matches

settings.name: UI_SSO_GROUP_ADMIN
settings.description: Group name that grants admin role (highest priority)

settings.name: UI_SSO_GROUP_WRITER
settings.description: Group name that grants writer role

settings.name: UI_SSO_GROUP_READER
settings.description: Group name that grants reader role

settings.name: UI_SSO_FALLBACK_TO_LOGIN
settings.description: Allow users to fall back to normal login when SSO headers are not present

settings.name: UI_SSO_UPDATE_USER_ON_LOGIN
settings.description: Update user information (email) from SSO headers on each login

settings.name: UI_SSO_SYNC_ROLES
settings.description: Synchronize user roles from SSO group mappings on each login when the groups header is present and at least one group mapping is configured

settings.name: UI_SSO_SYNC_ROLES_PROTECT_ADMIN
settings.description: Prevent SSO role sync from downgrading users who currently have the admin role

settings.name: UI_SSO_ACCOUNT_LINKING
settings.description: How to match incoming SSO users to local accounts

settings.name: UI_SSO_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URL
settings.description: URL to redirect users to after logout (e.g., SSO provider logout endpoint)
